meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (national, single-level corporate registry; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Civil Law rooted in Spanish tradition, with strong Common Law influence in corporate and commercial matters (Sociedad Anónima patterned on Delaware general corporation precedents)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended by Ley 70 de 2019 and Ley 129 de 2020); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 4 de 2020 (AML/CFT implementing regulation); VUIA supervisory resolutions; DGI regulations establishing the Registro de Titulares de Beneficiarios Finales (e-UBO filing module within the E-TAX portal, effective since 2023); Ley 57 de 2018 (registered-agent licensing requirements for abogados idóneos).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of country of origin (certified true copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Panama acceded effective 27 October 1991); Consular Legalization where the issuer is not an Apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banking reference letter for each initial shareholder or corporate beneficiary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization depending on jurisdiction of bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Legal Existence (Certificado de Personería Jurídica) for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (or equivalent constitutional documents) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or notary of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of ultimate beneficial owner (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) for the UBO registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of Panama or notary in document origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; internal corporate attestation accepted for DGI e-UBO filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or financial institution in the jurisdiction of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, directors, officers and UBOs against the VUIA (Unidad de Análisis Financiero) consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UN Consolidated List, EU terrorist list, and the Panamanian FIU national judicial lists; foreign PEPs and their family/close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD) with source-of-funds documentation; screening results must be documented and retained by the resident agent for a minimum of 5 years under Ley 23 de 2015.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – online name clearance and certification module (Registro Público en Línea / e-Name Clearance system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be drafted in Spanish, English, or any language using the Latin alphabet; non-Latin characters are not accepted without phonetic transliteration into the Latin script; the name must end with the closing suffix 'S.A.' or the words 'Sociedad Anónima' in full; acronyms and initialisms are permissible only if they form part of the full registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco – prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá
Financiera – prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá
Seguros / Reaseguros – prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros
Fondo / Fondos de Inversión – prior authorization from the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores
Valores / Bolsa – prior authorization from the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores
Gobierno / República / Nacional / Provincia – prior approval from the Ministerio de Gobierno
Fundación / Asociación / Cooperativa – reserved for other statutory legal forms
Universidad / Academia / Educación – prior approval from the Ministerio de Educación
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may immediately re-file the name search through the Registro Público en Línea with alternative variants; a written administrative reconsideration petition (incidente de contraste) may be filed within 5 business days of the rejection notice before the Certification and Name Unit of the Registro Público; if denied, the applicant may elevate an administrative appeal to the Director General del Registro Público within 10 business days; ex parte judicial review before the Jurisdicción Contencioso-Administrativa, Corte Suprema, remains available; in practice, refiling with a distinct denominative and jurisdictional disclaimers resolves most conflicts without trial.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A Sociedad Anónima must continuously maintain a licensed resident agent (agente residente) in Panama with a physical street address for service of process; the company itself is not required to maintain a physical local office, and the resident agent's address may be used for statutory communications. For the plush toy OEM scope (non-financial, low-risk), a virtual office arrangement with the resident agent is fully compliant, subject to the agent's registered-address infrastructure being physically verifiable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical inspection is low for this industry and entity profile: approximately 3–7% annual probability from VUIA for AML compliance inspections; the likelihood rises to approximately 15% if a Panamanian banking or platform payment facility is connected, triggering periodic verification by the Superintendencia de Bancos through the resident-agent relationship.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 32 of 26 February 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended, particularly Articles 1, 2, 5, 10, 12, 20, 21 and 32 (incorporation, capital, registered office, directors and officers); supplemented by the Public Registry tariff regulations and the consolidated Texto Único adopted by Executive Decree No. 2 of 2010.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Entities Section).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (notarial deed of incorporation comprising the Pacto Social and Estatutos).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. Authorized capital is freely fixed in the deed, with a customary floor of US$10,000 divided into 100 common shares; subscribed shares need not be fully paid at incorporation. Bearer shares, if authorized, must be immobilized with a licensed custodian under Law No. 22 of 2017.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF PANAMA PLUSH MANUFACTURING, S.A. The Directors, acting unanimously and pursuant to Articles of the Bylaws, RESOLVE: That the entire authorized share capital, comprising one hundred common shares of USD 100.00 par value each, is issued, allotted and subscribed in full by the founding subscribers; That the registered office of the Company is established at the registered address of the resident agent in Panama City; That the following officers are appointed: [PRESIDENT], President; [SECRETARY], Secretary; and [TREASURER], Treasurer; That the President and Secretary are jointly authorized to open bank accounts, execute commercial contracts, and file all municipal, tax, and environmental applications necessary for the commencement of business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, approval and notarization of the public deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the First Judicial Circuit of Panama (Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney to prepare the Pacto Social and Estatutos. At least two natural or legal incorporators must personally, or through a power of attorney, execute the corporate deed before the notary. The deed fixes the corporate name, purpose, authorized capital, share classes, bearer or registered share provisions, duration, registered agent appointment and governance framework. Upon execution, the notary issues the authorized copy (copia autorizada) required for registration.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each individual incorporator
Certificate of incorporation and apostilled power of attorney for any corporate incorporator
Corporate name reservation certificate (two alternative names)
Final draft of the Pacto Social and Estatutos
Instruction letter appointing the resident agent and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate name is rejected, request a new name reservation at the Public Registry and amend the deed by a notarized addendum prior to subscription; if the notary queries clauses, correct the defective clauses and re-execute the instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the corporate deed at the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed together with the name reservation certificate and the official tariff payment receipt with the Legal Entities Section. The Registry performs formal and legal review, assigns the corporate foja and issues the certificate of incorporation. Legal personality attaches only as of the inscription date.
required_dossiers: Authorized notarial copy (copia autorizada) of the public deed
Certificate of corporate name reservation
Official receipt of registry tariff payment
Power of attorney of the counsel or representative requesting registration
Notary's fiscal compliance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a written defect notice (calificación), file a responsive brief within 15 business days to cure or argue the objection; where the defect is substantive, execute a corrective notarial amendment deed and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration (RUC) with the General Directorate of Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic RUC application referencing the Registry foja of the S.A., the appointed legal representatives and the primary economic activity ISIC 3240 (Manufacture of toys and games). This activates territorial tax obligations and yields the RUC certificate required for invoicing, import duties and customs clearance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of inscription issued by the Public Registry
RUC application form signed by the legal representative
Copy of identification documents of officers and directors
Proof of registered / operating address (lease or utility bill)
Notarized power of attorney where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI requests additional evidence, respond through the electronic tax mailbox within 10 working days; failure to answer voids the application, requiring a fresh submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal operating notice (Aviso de Operación) for the industrial facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama – Dirección de Gestión de Ingresos (Tax Collection Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal business license covering the industrial activity at the proposed manufacturing site. The municipality verifies zoning compatibility, fire safety inspection, structural occupancy, and payment of the annual municipal operating tax. The license must be renewed annually and is a precondition for production start-up.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Fire department safety inspection certificate
Lease agreement or property title of the manufacturing site
Municipal zoning compatibility certificate
Company registration certificate (foja) and ID of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If denied on zoning grounds, apply for a special industrial use permit or relocate the plant to a zoned industrial district; if denied on fire safety grounds, cure the irregularities and re-submit the updated inspection certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental authorization filing under MiAMBIENTE (Category I)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación y Seguimiento Ambiental
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Environmental Compliance Declaration (Declaración de Impacto Ambiental) and site documentation through MiAMBIENTE's single window for classification as a low-impact light manufacturing facility. The approval letter must be kept on site and is required prior to production operations.
required_dossiers: Environmental compliance notification form
Site layout and machinery description of the plush manufacturing facility
Wastewater and solid waste management plan
Copy of the municipal Aviso de Operación and RUC
Industrial hygiene plan for fabric and fiber dust handling
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MiAMBIENTE reclassifies the activity as Category II, prepare and submit a Preliminary Environmental Impact Study (EsIA Preliminar) within the statutory deadline; if the application is incomplete, the agency may issue a single list of missing items with a further response period to complement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of statutory books, first board resolutions and resident agent certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office / authorized Panamanian law firm acting as resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Furnish the mandatory corporate books (share ledger, board minutes book, shareholders' minutes book and accounting records) as required for Panamanian S.A.s. Convene the first board meeting to adopt the governance resolutions, issue share certificates and record the acceptance of officer appointments. The resident agent must maintain a current register of the company's records.
required_dossiers: Bylaws and Public Registry inscription certificate
Share subscription list and share certificates
First board minutes and officer acceptance forms
Resident agent appointment and acceptance letter
Sworn statement of the company's accounting book authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If minutes or share certificates contain defects, adopt a ratification resolution at the next board meeting and, where required, pay the stamp tax and re-issue the affected certificates; any irregularity in the books may be cured by a sworn statement filed before the Public Registry or DGI.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección de Empresas e Industrias, acting jointly with the Municipality of Panama for the industrial operating permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Industrial (Municipal Industrial Operating Notice), supplemented by the Registro Industrial registration at MICI and the MiAMBIENTE environmental authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación y Seguimiento Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I – Declaración de Impacto Ambiental (Environmental Compliance Declaration) for low-impact light manufacturing; upgraded to Categoría II (Preliminary EsIA) where installed capacity, wastewater volume or VOC emissions exceed the thresholds set by MiAMBIENTE regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer must comply with DGD-VA-08-2009 and the applicable MINSA standards: pH 6.0–9.0, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L; fugitive volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from adhesives and silicone processes must meet the immission and emission limits of Executive Decree No. 306 of 2002; fabric scrap, plastic pellets and packaging waste must be segregated and transferred only to authorized waste management operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Pre-occupancy fire safety inspection and certificate of the Dirección de Bomberos de Panamá; municipal structural and occupancy inspection confirming the building is fit for industrial manufacturing; MINSA occupational health permit (Visa de Salud) for the premises; and registration of the workforce with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) for occupational injury risk coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — the revenue authority within the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) of the Republic of Panama. Primary taxpayer portal: e-Tax 2.0 (https://etax.mef.gob.pa); electronic-invoicing and clearance infrastructure: SIF (Sistema de Facturación Electrónica) operated by the DGI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Phase 1 — Corporate existence: incorporate the Sociedad Anónima through a Panamanian resident statutory legal agent; record the charter at the Registro Público and obtain the corporate Folio, certificado de existencia y representación, and the Municipality's Aviso de Operación. Phase 2 — RUC/TIN application: file the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application via the e-Tax portal or DGI service center, attaching the apostilled corporate documents, bylaws, statutory agent power of attorney, registered-address certificate, and ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO/KYC/AML) statement under Law 23 of 2015. Phase 3 — Issuance and enrolment: DGI issues the RUC within approximately 3–10 business days and enrols the company in the ITBMS taxpayer roll, mandatory employer registrations where payroll is anticipated, and the SIF e-invoicing schema. For exports, the S.A. separately enrolls as an Exportador with the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas to access the electronic export declaration channel. No minimum paid-in capital applies, and the S.A. may remain wholly foreign-owned and non-resident-managed; no national manufacturing license is required for plush-toy OEM production beyond the municipal operating notice.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of Panama has no central-issuing bank or foreign-exchange administration. The Banco Nacional de Panamá (state-owned commercial bank) acts as fiscal agent of the State but is constitutionally barred from issuing paper currency or performing lender-of-last-resort functions. Banking and FX-intermediary supervision is exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) under Decreto Ley 9 de 26 de febrero de 1998, as amended; the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) supervises AML/CFT compliance pursuant to Ley 23 de 2015.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system: the US dollar (USD) circulates as legal tender and is the settlement currency for all commercial and banking transactions; the Panamanian balboa (PAB) exists solely as subunit coinage at a statutory 1:1 fixed parity with USD and carries no independent exchange rate. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible; there are no exchange controls, no prior currency-purchase authorizations, no repatriation restrictions, and no profit-remittance licensing hurdles. Cross-border dividend payments are subject only to the territorial corporate income tax framework (10% withholding on dividends and a complementary tax on retained earnings under Ley 76 de 2019), not to FX controls. For the ISIC 3240 plush OEM company, all invoicing, treasury, payroll and vendor payments can be executed in USD without conversion friction, and any receivable or payable in a third currency (CNY, EUR, TWD) is freely negotiable through licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation exists. Panama imposes zero mandatory conversion ratios, zero repatriation timelines, and zero reporting thresholds for export proceeds surrendered to the State. The company may retain 100% of USD export receipts in any SBP-licensed bank or foreign account. The only compliance requirements are: (i) accurate entry of export transactions in the corporate accounting records to support territorial tax filings; (ii) retention of customs/proof-of-export documentation in case of a tax audit; and (iii) reporting of cash or wire flows to the UAF only where the single transaction or linked-series exceeds the established suspicious-transaction threshold.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc., Panama Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium with strict legal constraints. Panama's Ley 71 de 2019 regulates fintech and crowdfunding activities, but it does not create an EU-style electronic-money-institution passport and does not authorize offshore digital EMIs to take deposits or hold a Panamanian account numbering facility. An unlicensed offshore EMI (e.g., a non-Panama payment intermediary) may lawfully serve only as a settlement/payout gateway for platform revenues, provided the Panama S.A. remains the recorded beneficiary of the underlying funds and the EMI submits itself to CDD at the receiving Panamanian bank. The EMI must provide: (i) a UBO attestation; (ii) its payment-service license from the home regulator; and (iii) a reference letter from its corresponding bank. Operating the EMI as the primary liquidity rail is not viable because Panamanian banks will reject a corporate account whose main inflow originates from an unregulated pass-through design; the recommended architecture is one tier-1 Panamanian operational account as the treasury core, with the EMI used ancillary for marketplace payouts under USD 50,000 per event.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP-regulated banks accept remote onboarding for non-resident directors and shareholders, but the process is conditional on an enforceable video-identification interview and apostilled documentation. Banco General, Banistmo and Multibank require at least one live video call with the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and a notarized signatory card; Towerbank and BAC similarly permit a remote interview if the corporate package is certified by the Panamanian resident agent. A mandatory physical appearance arises only where the UBO appears on a sanctions or Politically Exposed Persons list, or where the beneficial owner resides in a jurisdiction classified by the SBP as higher-risk; in those cases an in-person visit to the branch before a notary public is required. Standard onboarding timeline for a clean UBO is 15–30 business days from receipt of the complete dossier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO is a non-resident individual with no Panamanian tax ID and no in-country physical address
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport copy; certified proof of residential address; UBO declaration signed under penalty of perjury; notarized copy of the Escritura Pública de Constitución; Registro Público Certificate of Good Standing; officer and incumbency certificate; resident-agent certification; corporate-law-firm reference letter; source-of-funds statement with supporting bank records; non-PEP sworn declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recently incorporated S.A. (under 12 months) with no audited financial statements and no operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly nil or minimal tax returns (MMP) filed with DGI; warehouse or production-space lease in Panama; signed raw-material purchase order from a recognized fabric or polyfill supplier; executed customer purchase agreement or marketplace seller contract evidencing genuine plush-toy activity; 12-month cash-flow forecast in USD; reference letter from the home-country relationship bank; business plan describing the ISIC 3240 OEM commercial model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flag from fabric imports out of China or Turkey where invoice value, freight and third-party payment channels are mismatched
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial invoices and packing lists; Panamanian customs clearance declarations; bills of lading; SWIFT MT103 payment confirmations made directly to the registered supplier account; supplier business-license translation; formal third-party payer authorization letter with payer KYC; internal TBML risk assessment explaining the commercial rationale for triangular payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency inbound platform payouts (Amazon, Etsy, storefront settlement) commingled with marketing fees and refunds, trigger the bank's threshold-monitoring system
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed marketplace seller agreement naming the Panama S.A. as beneficiary; PSP account ownership certificate; monthly payout and settlement statements; reconciliation ledger matching SKU and ISIC 3240 product descriptions to invoiced amounts; local business license and tax registration; consumer-refund policy documentation demonstrating bona fide operational flow.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire protocol for capital and customer receipts: (1) Inward USD remittances arrive via SWIFT MT103 through the bank's New York correspondent into the company's SBP-licensed Panama account; the beneficiary name must exactly match the registered corporate account profile to avoid name-control rejection. (2) Purpose codes: direct paid-in capital (approval by board resolution and reflected in the Registro Público share-capital register; no Ministry authorization required), shareholder loan (documented in writing with arm's length interest rate and commercial substance; subject to thin-capitalization and transfer-pricing rules if the company elects taxable local activity), or advanced customer payment for future OEM export invoices (record as customer deposit against the purchase order). (3) Verification bundle: certified Escritura Pública; formation minutes approving the capital injection; UBO declaration; for amounts above USD 50,000, the underlying shareholder resolution, source-of-funds confirmation, and, for trade prepayments exceeding USD 100,000, a copy of the signed PO and proforma invoice. (4) Timing: USD clears in same-day value; the bank reconciles against the pre-notified Treasury statement; no foreign-exchange ticket is created because USD is the local unit of account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for settlement: (1) SWIFT MT103 is the standard rail for raw-material, design-agency and logistics disbursements of any size; for payments above USD 250,000 the treasury must evaluate MT202 COV cover instructions so that beneficiary-country reporting captures the remitter in full step-in format. (2) Commercial letters of credit under UCP600 are the preferred rail for bulk polyfill and fabric imports from China and Turkey; a confirmed irrevocable L/C issued by Banistmo, Multibank or Banco General, with US correspondent confirmation, transfers payment risk to the issuing bank and protects the Panama S.A. against documentary non-compliance. (3) Domestic ACH Panama and the high-value SIPAV network are used for payroll, rent and local vendor settlement in balboa or USD at 1:1. (4) Platform payout rails (Stripe, PayPal, Payoneer) are authorized for marketplace sales refunds and small marketing disbursements subject to a USD 10,000 single-event cap. (5) Every outgoing payment must embed the corporate invoice reference and be mapped to the approved trade basket; any invoice deviation above 10% requires a Treasury exception memo and second signatory approval.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla FX forward contracts booked with an SBP-licensed bank or registered broker-dealer, available only where the company carries a genuine CNY, EUR or TWD cost exposure; USD/PAB forwards are inapplicable because of the fixed 1:1 legal peg.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY/TWD/EUR for hedging raw-material import costs; permitted when executed through a global markets desk with a lawful Panamanian corporate counterparty and supported by the underlying trade contract; net settlements are made in USD with no central-bank approval required.

Cross-currency swaps (USD against CNY/EUR) to convert a shareholder loan or receivable exposure; permissible provided the transaction is registered in the corporate accounts as a cash-flow hedge, the ISDA master agreement is executed, and notional exposure above USD 1,000,000 is approved by the board.

European-style FX call and put options on third currencies, evidenced by an ISDA agreement and board authorization; speculative option trading without an underlying trade flow is discouraged and may be declined by Panamanian banks.

Multi-currency documentary letters of credit under UCP600 that permit repayment in CNY or EUR through a negotiated LC bifurcation clause; treated as an approved hedging-instrument alternative when the transaction is directly linked to the underlying purchase order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Panama Public Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after each corporate anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 plus interest; failure to file for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and loss of juridical personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge plus monthly compensatory interest of 0.5%; persistent non-payment for over two years may result in tax lien and administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración Jurada de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end (March 31 for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of USD 100 plus 0.5% monthly interest on unpaid tax; non-filing can result in forced assessment and tax collection enforcement.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is triggered when annual gross revenues exceed USD 2,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 1,500,000; smaller corporations may present unaudited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Colegio de Contadores Públicos de Panamá; IFRS for SMEs permitted for entities below the audit threshold.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 23 of 2015 and the Final Beneficiary Registry Regulations, every corporation must file an annual sworn statement confirming current ultimate beneficial ownership information before March 31 of each year. Any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be registered in the share transfer ledger and updated in the Beneficiary Registry within 30 days of the underlying transaction.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 6,000 for a standard audited financial statement package; lower for unaudited review.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday applies to a standard Panamanian S.A. conducting ISIC 3240 plush toy manufacturing. The territorial regime excludes foreign-source income from the taxable base. A small taxpayer with gross annual revenue not exceeding B/.200,000 may elect the fixed-quota (CAF) regime instead of the 25% corporate rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1910 (Declaración Anual de Renta – Persona Jurídica) filed electronically through the DGI Sede Electrónica (e-Tax) at sede.dgi.gob.pa
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than March 31 of the following year. Quarterly advance instalments are due June 30, September 30, and December 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number assigned by the DGI for the Panamanian S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Panamanian RUC of the company; the foreign shareholder identification is not entered on Form 1910.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross Panama-source revenue from manufacturing and sale of plush mascots, including export sales produced in Panama; record gross revenue before deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include the full invoiced amount of the OEM manufacturing contracts; exclude non-Panamanian commissions and foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses attributable to plush toy production: raw materials, ultrasonic welding and embroidery subcontracts, payroll, freight, depreciation, and allocated administrative overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apportion deductions on a source basis; expenses paid to foreign related parties must comply with transfer pricing rules and be supported by valid invoices and tax residency certificates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income computed as gross revenue less deductible costs and expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the net figure reflects only Panama-source income; foreign-source income must be excluded from the calculation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory corporate income tax at 25% applied to the net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The tax is assessed against the S.A. itself, not against its foreign shareholders, regardless of beneficial ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advanced income tax payments, customer withholdings, and tax credits applied against the calculated tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain the withholding certificates for each credit claimed; this line is not affected by the non-resident status of shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 – Saldo a pagar o saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due after credits or the amount of carry-forward credit to be recovered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a treaty-related refund is sought, the refund claim is processed on behalf of the Panamanian S.A. by its resident agent and requires supporting residency documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: surcharge of 10% of the tax due (not less than B/.50) plus moratorium interest at 1.5% per month on unpaid tax; failure to file allows the DGI to make an 'aforo de oficio' assessment and impose fines of up to B/.5,000; criminal evasion penalties apply where false information conceals tax of more than B/.50,000.
